dataset.title: Drone Building Scans — Two Commercial Buildings
dataset.licenseScope: Dataset card declares CC BY 4.0; source README specifically says this licence covers imagery. Do not assume it licenses the separate reference GLB or third-party signage/trademarks.
dataset.attribution: Drone Building Scans — Matthew Guertin, 2026. CC BY 4.0. https://github.com/Matt1Up/drone-building-scans-dataset

calibrationContext.note: The dataset README says the metric reference scan used this bar as control. Reusing that same bar as an independent hold-out would be leakage.

knownLimitations: This intake verifies one image's downloaded bytes only; it does not establish that a full multi-view capture was acquired.
The published flat-roof GLB is a textured photogrammetry model from the same capture imagery, not independent surveyed ground truth; its licence scope was not independently established.
The 1.997 m AprilTag bar is described as having been used as control to scale the reference scan, so it is not automatically an independent held-out checkpoint.
No independent full-building survey, independently measured footprint/dimensions, vertical datum or held-out check point set is supplied by this manifest.
Image-source licence declaration and source-owner authority have not been independently authenticated.
